notes.title: Developer Diary 🦆 | Official Q&A​
notes.content: [p]After announcing the release date for Duckov, dev team have been flooded with amazing feedback from all of you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]THANK YOU SO MUCH for your support!!​​[/b] [/p][p]We’ve been reading everycomment, checking discussions daily, and soaking up all the love. Seriously — you guys are the reason we push harder every day.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🔙 Quick Recap: What Was the Demo About?[/b][/p][p]Back in May, we released a demo to test the stability.[/p][p]It included:[/p][list][*][p][b]​​2 Maps​​[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]​​40+ Missions​​[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]​​~6–10 Hours of Gameplay​​[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The response blew us away. Your support meant the world to us — truly.[/p][p]Then, when the demo was delisted in August, the #1 question we heard was:[/p][p][b]​​“When’s the full game?!“​​ 😄[/b][/p][p]And honestly… that excitement fuels everything we do.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🦆 So, What’s NEW in the Full Release?[/b][/h2][p]We’ve been hard at work turning Duckov into the game you deserve. Here’s what’s waiting for you at launch:[/p][p][b]🎮 ​​Expanded Gameplay​​[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]​​Demo:​​ [/b]~6–10 hours[/p][/*][*][p][b]​​Full Game:​​ ​​50+ hours​​ [/b]on your first playthrough (and yes, there's even morebeyond that!)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🧩 ​​More Missions​​[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]​​Demo:​​ [/b]40+[/p][/*][*][p][b]​​Full Game:​​ ​​4–5x more quests​​ [/b]— with wilder objectives, deeper stories, and more chaos.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342384/3193b8ef01f4b2d75fe214d2a659e98406d9a0da.png"][/img][/p][p][b]🗺️ ​​5 Maps (Including 3 Brand-New Ones!)​​[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]​​Demo:​​ [/b]Maps 1 & 2[/p][/*][*][p][b]​​Full Game:​​ ​​3 NEW maps[/b]​​, each one[b] ​​bigger and more detailed​​[/b] than the last. Get ready to explore![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342384/833216a813a77e6146a080ed35dc3cc727120f86.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]🔫 ​​More Weapons & Gear​​[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]​​Over 50+ weapons​​ [/b]+ all your favorite mods.[/p][/*][*][p]Build the ultimate loadout. Go loud. Go stealth. Go Duck.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]📈 ​​Deeper Progression​​[/b][/p][list][*][p]Expanded skill trees[/p][/*][*][p]Black Market upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Workshop progression system[/p][/*][*][p]And yes… ​​our [b]Ducklings trained at Mud’s Gym and can now punch Gundam-sized enemies.​​[/b] (Okay, maybe not quite, but they’re tougher than ever.)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342384/a6415746caadf1393b8314ccb64198266047b1e3.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]​​💬 A Little Heart-to-Duck from the Team​​[/b][/h3][p]The demo was just the beginning — a way to let you dip your toes into Duckov’s world. The full game dives deeper into the story, characters, and the wild, unpredictable chaos that makes Duckov… Duckov.[/p][p][/p][p][b]​​And this is only the beginning.​​[/b][/p][p]Here’s what’s coming ​​[b]after launch​​:[/b][/p][p][b]✅ ​​New weapons, gear, and items​​[/b][/p][p][b]✅ ​​Potential collabs? (Stay tuned… 👀)​​[/b][/p][p][b]✅ ​​Your voice shapes Duckov’s future​​[/b] — community feedback will drive updates, events, and more![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342384/ee538ea806bdf8422b1ce931d8d36cb66a9f9ecc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for helping this little duckling take flight.  [/p][p]Now let’s waddle farther — together. 🦆💙[/p][p][/p][h3][b]❓ Common Q&A​​[/b][/h3][p][b]​​Q: Will demo saves carry over?​​[/b][/p][p]A: [b]​​No.​​[/b] The full game has major updates under the hood. For the best experience, we recommend starting fresh.[/p][p][b]Q: Is there cloud save support?​​[/b][/p][p]A:[b] ​​Yes — on Steam, Epic.​[/b][/p][p][b]Q: Is there a Mac version?​​[/b][/p][p]A: [b]​​Yes.​​[/b] Available on ​​[b]Steam and the Mac App Store.​​[/b][/p][p][b]​​Q: Will there be MODs & Workshop support?​​[/b][/p][p]A: ​​[b]Absolutely[/b].​​ Get creative![/p][p][b]​​Q: Will my PC run it?​​[/b][/p][p]A: Here are the ​​[b]minimum & recommended specs​​:[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]​​[/b]Minimum Specs:​​[/h3][p][b]​​OS:[/b]​​ Windows 10 (64-bit)[/p][p][b]​​CPU:​​[/b] Intel Core i7-9700[/p][p][b]​​RAM:[/b]​​ 8GB[/p][p][b]​​GPU:[/b]​​ GTX 1060[/p][p][b]​​Storage:[/b]​​ 16GB[/p][h3]​​Recommended:​​[/h3][p]​​GPU:​​ GTX 2060[/p][p]​​RAM:​​ 16GB[/p][p][/p][p](Full FAQ coming pre-launch—stay posted.)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342384/497b45831f59f5ba012d5513bacd6b64c3f5139f.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]🆘 Need Help or Just Wanna Chat?[/b] [/h3][p]Join our ​​[b]Discord community[/b]​​: [url="https://discord.gg/BAgYfrSBaS"]https://discord.gg/BAgYfrSBaS[/url]  [/p][p]We’re always around to answer questions, share updates, and hang out with fellow Ducklings.[/p]

notes.title: Dev Diary 🦆丨Release Date Announced!
notes.content: [p]It’s been almost a month since the demo closed, and the most frequent question we’ve heard is:  [/p][h3][b]"When is the game actually coming out?"[/b]  [/h3][p](And of course, many passionate players have already answered: “Soon!”)  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Well, today we can finally say— October 16th is the day we’re serving it up hot for you all![/b][/h3][p]During the last demo test, we received an overwhelming amount of feedback from you wonderful folks who tried the game.  [/p][h3][b]A huge, heartfelt thank you for your support!![/b]  [/h3][p][/p][p]Here’s what we’ve improved based on your input:  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]1. Difficulty – Now Fully Customizable[/b][/h3][p](Because everyone’s playstyle is different—some love a challenge, others just want to loot in peace.)  [/p][p]Since players come from varied gaming backgrounds, perceptions of difficulty vary widely.  [/p][p]So in the full release, we’re introducing: Custom Difficulty Settings!  [/p][p]Adjust enemy HP, player damage taken, item drop rates, and more—tailor your perfect "Duckov" world and scavenge to your heart’s content, quack-quack![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342384/df69d67d36e4d7ee3ee07e488b77e95b4aa602dd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. New Player Guidance – Smoother First Steps[/b][/h3][p](No more confusion for newcomers—now even if you’re new to this genre, you’ll get the hang of it fast.)  [/p][p]Previously, players unfamiliar with this type of game sometimes struggled at first.  [/p][p]In the full version, we’ve added a dedicated tutorial area and refined our guidance—so even first-timers can dive into the thrill of "loot, fight, extract" without a hitch. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342384/147825e8ca8ffb986b4dfda36138bec3d99f858a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. Inventory – More Space, Better Organization[/b][/h3][p](For all you hoarder-types out there—we heard you loud and clear: "Not enough bags!"  [/p][p]Some players felt the backpack was too small, storage limited, and sorting a hassle.  [/p][p]In the full release, we’re boosting stack limits for more item types, expanding backpack capacity, and increasing carry weight. The warehouse also gets a size upgrade—hoarding just got happier, quack-quack![/p][p]Plus: New inventory features like item locking and one-click sorting make looting smoother than ever!  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]4. Controls – Wheel Scrolling & Side-Button Bindings Added[/b][/h3][p](Remember those early demo requests? Yep, we delivered back in June.)  [/p][p]The most common control requests (mouse wheel swapping and side-button bindings) were updated way back in June.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]5. Black Market – Faster Refreshes, More Drops[/b][/h3][p](No more waiting forever for the good stuff.)  [/p][p]Late in the demo, many of you complained about the long refresh timers for the black market.  [/p][p]In the full release, we’ve upgraded the system—more refreshes, shorter cooldowns, and better rewards. Now you can farm those rare items like a pro. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]6. Multiplayer, Controller & Console Support[/b][/h3][p](Big ask, but not forgotten.)  [/p][p]Many of you asked about multiplayer, controller support, and console versions.  [/p][p]These aren’t in the initial launch, as Duckov was originally designed for keyboard & mouse. Adapting controllers and consoles requires significant work, and our team is currently focused on polishing new content.  [/p][p]But don’t worry—we’ll seriously evaluate post-launch feasibility. Stay tuned!  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]7. More Content? Oh, We’ve Got You Covered.[/b][/h3][p](“Too little to play?” Not anymore. New maps? Weapons? Skills? NPCs? Check, check, and check.)  [/p][p]Some of you said: "Not enough content!"  [/p][p]Well, guess what? The full release has all that—and more.  [/p][p](Saw something weird and high-tech in the PV? Some very tech-bro looking facilities? We’ll say no more… for now.)  [/p][p]The full version holds even more surprises waiting to be uncovered.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]8. Tons of Bug Fixes & Quality-of-Life Upgrades[/b][/h3][p](We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes.)  [/p][p]Over the past few months, the team has been rigorously playtesting, fine-tuning numbers, and polishing every detail.  [/p][p]Our goal? For you to experience pure, unfiltered fun in Duckov—and for you to genuinely think, “Damn, this is a great game.”  [/p][p]Fun is the #1 priority. Quack-quack-quack!!  [/p][p][/p][p]Before launch, if you have any questions, join our official Discord:  [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/BAgYfrSBaS"]https://discord.gg/BAgYfrSBaS[/url][/p][p]And if you haven’t added Duckov to your wishlist yet—  [/p][p]What are you waiting for? [b]Wishlist Now![/b] (Thanks, quack-quack!)  [/p]

notes.title: It’s a perfect day for an adventure! | ESCAPE FROM DUCKOV
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="1-VqL4FBFrY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Escape from Duckov is a Top-Down PVE Looter Extraction Shooter, where you are a plucky duck let loose in a deceptively dangerous world. Don't be fooled by the quiet, or the gentle quack, quack of your own webbed feet. In the dead zones of Duckov, every shadow could hide a new threat—or the score of a lifetime. [/p][p]It will test your wits, your trigger finger, and your uncanny ability to haul back piles of junk, upgrade your secret base, and eventually build the rocket you need to finally Escape from Duckov. [/p][p]Steam Next Fest is ON, and the quacking has officially begun! [/p][p]📅 Demo Available: June 9, 2025 @ 10:00 AM PST / 1:00 PM EST [/p][p]💬 Join our Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/BAgYfrSBaS"]https://discord.gg/BAgYfrSBaS[/url][/p]

notes.title: Attention Ducklings with crash issues:
notes.content:
Dear Ducklings,
If you encounter a game crash during gameplay, in order to help us pinpoint the root cause and fix it more accurately, please preserve the state immediately and provide us with the following key information:
· Package and send us your save file and log files. The save file path is: %appdata%\..\locallow\teamsoda\duckov (Please avoid including screenshot files to prevent the package from becoming too large)
· Provide your device information, including: CPU model, GPU model, Memory (RAM) specification and size, Type of storage drive (SSD or HDD) where the Duckov game files are stored.
We also kindly request Ducklings experiencing crash issues to send the information to our email: duckov@bilibili.com, to provide us with further feedback on the problem Quack~

Hi, everyone!
I'm Ducky, and Jeff is working hard on building Ducktopia! 🦆 Come join us in this quacky adventure and help us make history!

​​Opens:​​ May 28, 2025 at 9:00 PM (UTC-7)
​​Closes:​​ July 1, 2025 at 3:00 AM (UTC-7)

Since our last test, we've made the following updates:
✨ Core System Upgrades
Dynamic Environment: Introduced day-night cycles and real-time weather. Nighttime limits visibility and spawns exclusive monsters.
Combat Enhancements: Added dedicated slots for melee weapons (permanently held), active headshot mechanics, and recoil simulation for firearms.
Navigation Optimization: Implemented sound direction indicators, seamless map transitions, and a beacon teleportation system (reduced construction resource requirements).
Economic System: Introduced cash trading and map merchants, along with an equipment dismantling feature (one-click dismantle at the workbench).
🎯 Content Expansion
New Player Friendly: Added a prologue tutorial stage and enhanced early-game quest guidance.
Armory Upgrade: Introduced over 20 new firearms and redesigned all weapon models and icons.
Attachment Diversification: Expanded the attachment pool, offering branches focusing on attack, stability, and stealth attributes.

This is our early demo build. If you enjoy it, please ​​add our game to your wishlist​​ – your support means everything to us!

notes.title: Answers to Some Questions Everyone is Concerned About
notes.content:
Recently, besides receiving a lot of suggestions from everyone, we’ve also encountered many issues that players have faced.
I’ve compiled some of the most common questions here for everyone to check out.
I used translation software, so if anything is unclear, please leave a comment and let me know!

[h1]About Basic Game Questions[/h1]
Q1: I really want to play with my friends! Does the game include a multiplayer mode?
A: Duckov is a single-player game and does not include multiplayer features.

Q2: Can I play it on my phone?
A: There are currently no plans to release it on mobile platforms...

Q3: Does the game support controllers?
A: Not at the moment.

Q4: Will it support MAC computers?
A: The current DEMO version does not support MAC, but the full release will!

Q5: Does the game support cloud saves?
A: The DEMO version does not support cloud saves, but the full version will. Also, Steam achievements will only be available in the full version.

Q6: Will there be a Steam Workshop?
A: This is still undecided. We’ll need to wait until the core development is complete before making a decision.

[h1]About Major Bugs in This Test[/h1]
Q1: Sometimes, the GPU usage is too high.
A: In the future, we’ll add an FPS cap setting. Currently, the cap is 144 FPS, which does put a high load on the GPU. We’ll also add more graphics settings to meet the needs of more players.

Q2: Why is my game screen purple?
A: Based on the information we’ve gathered, it’s likely because the game does not support integrated graphics cards. (orz)

Q3: If there’s a power outage or crash during gameplay, the save file will be lost.
A: QAQ First of all, we sincerely apologize for this issue. We’ve received multiple reports about this problem, and unfortunately, we currently cannot fix it. We’ve roughly identified the cause of the bug and will resolve it in the next test!

Q4: Strange map glitches and invisible walls.
A: Aaaah, please report these to us! We’ll fix them as soon as possible! (orz)

[h1]About Future Plans[/h1]
Q1: When will we be able to play next?
A: After this playtest ends, we’ll adjust the game based on the feedback we’ve received.
We’ll open another test during the Steam Next Fest in June! In terms of content, the next DEMO won’t include new maps, but we’ll optimize the tutorial, improve the quest experience, and address other frequently reported issues. Everything will be optimized!!
Around June, we’ll also finalize a release date for the full game. We’ll definitely deliver it this year!

Q2: What will the business model be like? How much will it cost?
A: Duckov will be a one-time purchase game with no in-game purchases. The exact price hasn’t been decided yet, but we’ll respect and consider everyone’s suggestions.

Q3: Will the current DEMO save files be compatible with the full version?
A: Actually, we can’t deliberately delete your save files (since they’re stored locally for single-player games).
However, because we’ve updated the game, old save files might trigger unexpected bugs.
Additionally, in the new version, we’ll update quests, optimize the early-game experience, adjust enemy and weapon stats, add official Steam achievements, and make a series of other adjustments.
Therefore, we recommend starting a new save file when the full game is released.

notes.title: "Escape from Duckov" STEAM Wishlist Reaches 100,000!!!
notes.content:
I’ve been thinking about writing a thank-you letter to express my thoughts, hoping you won’t laugh at me.

We started preparing for the Steam release around mid-December, 
and at first, we were really nervous. Every day was filled with endless bug fixes. 

Then we received the notice that we’d be opening the DEMO during China’s holiday period, which was a sudden decision. To be honest, our small team was quite anxious, constantly making adjustments. Mr. Jeff often joked, “Every build of this game feels like a different one!” Even during the holidays, we kept searching for feedback daily, afraid we might miss something.

Over the past few days, we’ve received messages from players around the world. Then, just recently, when I checked the backend, I was surprised to find that 100,000 people have added our game to their wishlist!!!

I sincerely thank everyone for their support!
We hope that on the day of the official release, we can truly live up to everyone’s expectations!

Additionally, as a token of our appreciation, we’ve decided to extend the test DEMO period by one more week.
The new closing time for the DEMO is 9:00 PM UTC on February 16, 2025, If you haven’t had enough fun yet, feel free to continue grinding for another week!
